hook.text: What does a note look like?

text.formula: A round plate: circles and spokes

youtube.title: Sand shows the shape of a note 🔊 #shorts
youtube.description:
A plate vibrates at one note. Sand is thrown off where the plate moves and gathers on the lines that stand still. Higher notes have more still lines.

#satisfying #simulation #shorts

hook.text: Can you see a sound wave?

text.formula: Dust piles where the air stays still
One end closed: odd harmonics only

youtube.title: Dust in a tube shows standing waves 🎵 #shorts
youtube.description:
A sound wave stands still in each tube and the dust piles up at the still points. Tube k fits k half-waves; a tube closed at one end only fits odd ones.

#satisfying #simulation #shorts
youtube.tags: math, physics, learn, education, science, satisfying, shorts

text.formula: Delay each source: the beam turns

youtube.title: Waves add up, and cancel out 🌊 #shorts
youtube.description:
Where a crest meets a crest the waves add up; where a crest meets a trough they cancel and the sand stays. Delay each source a little and the strong beam turns: that is how phased arrays steer.

#satisfying #simulation #shorts

hook.text: Can you see a magnetic field?

text.formula: Filings line up along the field
Opposite poles join, same poles push
A wire with a current: circles

youtube.title: Iron filings make magnetic fields visible 🧲 #shorts
youtube.description:
Each filing turns along the field. Around a magnet the lines run from pole to pole; around a wire carrying a current they go in circles.

#satisfying #simulation #shorts
